luck.title: Luck
luck.lucky: Lucky spins: every {n}th spin gets x{mult} luck.
luck.how: Every rarity is a "1 in X" chance. Luck divides X: with ×2 luck, a 1 in 400 Legendary becomes 1 in 200.
luck.badLuck: Bad luck protection: from Dumpster Level {level}, after {n} spins in a row without Epic or better, the next spin is guaranteed Epic or better.
luck.slots: Each spin picks one of the 10 gear slots with equal chance. An item's "1 in X" is the chance of its rarity and enchantments at base luck.
luck.revealBar: Full-screen reveal: your rarest find in {n} minutes ({rarity} or rarer). Rarest in an hour or more makes it bigger. It goes by what's rare for you now, so it stays special however lucky you get.
luck.hyperBar: HYPER RARE: the rarest find you've ever had, 1 in {odds} or rarer for you. It gets a showcase of its own.
luck.potionDrop: Luck Potions (×{mult} luck for {s}s) drop from mini-bosses, bosses, and rarely from any wave.

upgradeDesc.xpPct: More XP from fights and scrap.

heistUi.title: HEISTS
heistUi.sub: Rob a joint: 3 acts of 6 stops, then the boss. Get busted and you keep half the loot.
heistUi.lockedText: Short roguelite runs on a pizza place, a mall and a fancy hotel: perks, traps, shops and a boss, for Trash Bags, gold, Gems and rings found nowhere else.
heistUi.noPerks: No perks yet. Level up in fights to pick some.
heistUi.wheelHint: Spin it. What could go wrong?
heistUi.shrineText: It hums. It wants {pct}% of your max HP ({hp}) and offers an Epic perk.
heistUi.secondChance: Second chance? Get back up at half HP.
heistUi.lostSub: You got away with half the loot.
heist.log.act: Act {act}. It gets harder from here.
heist.log.elite: An elite guard blocks the way!
heist.log.secondChance: Second Chance? Get back up at {pct}% HP.
heist.log.lost: The heist failed. You keep {pct}% of the loot.
heist.log.won: {boss} is down! The heist is a success.
heist.log.perksFull: No room for more perks: healed {hp} HP instead.
heist.log.flipHeads: Coin flip: heads! +{pct}% ATK this fight.
heist.log.flipTails: Coin flip: tails. -{pct}% ATK this fight.
heist.log.nineLives: Nine Lives! You get back up.
heist.log.savedHeal: You eat the saved snack: +{hp} HP.
heist.log.noPerkCoins: Nothing new to learn there: +{coins} coins instead.
heist.log.truce: No fights for the next {n} stops.
heist.log.noTraps: No traps for the rest of this act.
heist.log.savedHealSet: Saved for later: heals {pct}% when you drop under {below}% HP.
heist.log.golden: A GOLDEN DUMPSTER! Your next {spins} spins roll at ×{mult} luck.
heist.log.trapDisarmed: A trap, but you saw it coming.
heist.log.trapSpotted: {trap}! But you saw it coming and tiptoe around it.
heist.log.shop: A shady shop opens its coat.
heist.log.restock: The shop digs out more perks.
heist.log.shrine: A glowing shrine wants {pct}% of your max HP.
heist.log.shrineAccept: You give the shrine {pct}% of your max HP.
heist.log.shrineDecline: You back away from the shrine.
heist.log.wheelPerk: The wheel lands on a perk!
heist.outcome.eliteBonus: An elite fight (×{mult} coins and XP)
heist.trap.box_on_a_stick.name: Box on a Stick
heist.trap.box_on_a_stick.text: There's a cookie under it. You know it's a trap. You go for the cookie anyway.
heist.trap.wet_floor_sign.name: Wet Floor Sign
heist.trap.wet_floor_sign.text: It warned you. You read it. You ran anyway.
heist.trap.glitter_bomb.name: Glitter Bomb
heist.trap.glitter_bomb.text: A birthday card goes off in your paws. You'll be sparkly for weeks.
heist.trap.robot_vacuum.name: Robot Vacuum with a Grudge
heist.trap.robot_vacuum.text: It has waited its whole life for this. It bumps your ankles. Again. And again.
heist.trap.floss_tripwire.name: Floss Tripwire
heist.trap.marble_hallway.name: Hallway of Marbles
heist.trap.marble_hallway.text: Somebody spilled a whole bag of marbles. You learn to skate. Badly.
heist.trap.sprinkler.name: Motion-Sensor Sprinkler
heist.trap.sprinkler.text: It finds you wherever you stand. Wet raccoon smell, everywhere.
heist.trap.lawn_rake.name: Rake on the Lawn
heist.trap.lawn_rake.text: Somebody left it out. You step on it. The handle swings up to say hi to your face.
heist.trap.flour_avalanche.name: Flour Avalanche
heist.trap.flour_avalanche.text: Fifty pounds of flour. You're a ghost now. A delicious ghost.
heist.trap.dough_mixer.name: Runaway Dough Mixer
heist.trap.dough_mixer.text: It grabs your tail and takes you for a few laps around the bowl.
heist.trap.hot_pizza_stone.name: Hot Pizza Stone
heist.trap.hot_pizza_stone.text: Fresh out of the oven. You sat on it. Why did you sit on it?
heist.trap.rolling_pin.name: Chef Tony's Rolling Pin
heist.trap.rolling_pin.text: It rolls off the shelf the second you walk under it. Chef Tony planned this.
heist.trap.perfume_ambush.name: Perfume Sample Ambush
heist.trap.perfume_ambush.text: A kiosk worker spritzes you with Midnight Musk. You smell like a department store now.
heist.trap.wrong_way_escalator.name: Wrong-Way Escalator
heist.trap.wrong_way_escalator.text: You run and run and stay exactly where you are.
heist.trap.nacho_cheese_pump.name: Nacho Cheese Pump
heist.trap.nacho_cheese_pump.text: You pressed it once. It hasn't stopped. It's hotter than it looks.
heist.trap.demo_drone.name: Toy Store Demo Drone
heist.trap.demo_drone.text: It has chased you since the toy store. Nobody can find the remote.
heist.trap.segway.name: Mall Cop Doug's Segway
heist.trap.segway.text: Parked at the top of the ramp. Was parked.
heist.trap.revolving_door.name: Revolving Door
heist.trap.revolving_door.text: Around and around. You see the lobby nine times. Nice lobby, though.
heist.trap.luggage_cart.name: Runaway Luggage Cart
heist.trap.luggage_cart.text: It rolls down the hall with you on it. There is no hill. Nobody knows how.
heist.trap.silver_platter.name: Silver Platter Mousetrap
heist.trap.silver_platter.text: You lift the shiny lid on a room service tray. It's a mousetrap. A very fancy one.
heist.trap.front_desk_bell.name: Front Desk Bell
heist.trap.front_desk_bell.text: DING. You can't stop ringing it. DING. Everyone hears. DING.
heist.trap.velvet_rope.name: The Concierge's Velvet Rope
heist.trap.velvet_rope.text: It's there to keep raccoons out. You trip over it. It works.
perks.title: PERKS
perks.sub: Beat a world for the first time this run: +{n} Half-Eaten Bread Loaf. Rebirth eats every loaf and perk, so each run grows a new combo.
perks.hint: Tap a perk to see what it does
perks.lockedToast: Perks open at Rebirth {n}! Keep going.
perks.wipes: A rebirth wipes your perks and loaves.
perkTreeLine.crew: Friends from the bottom of the bin.
perkTreeLine.chaos: Every raccoon's favorite life coach: nobody.
perkTreeLine.reels: The house always wins. You're the house now.
perkLine.pigeonWingman: A one-legged pigeon who owes you a favor.
perkFx.pigeonWingman: Pecks the front enemy for {pigeonAtkPct}% of your ATK every {pigeonEvery}s.
perkLine.sewerCousins: They chew through everything. Including your enemies.
perkFx.sewerCousins: Rats gnaw every enemy on screen for {ratAtkPct}% of your ATK every {ratEvery}s.
perkLine.drSqueaks: Not a real doctor. Really good at it, though.
perkFx.drSqueaks: Heals you {healPct}% of your max HP every {healEvery}s in a fight.
perkLine.seagullStrike: It came for your fries. It stayed for the violence.
perkFx.seagullStrike: Every {gullEvery}s it dive-bombs every enemy for {gullAtkPct}% of your ATK.
perkLine.raccoonMafia: Beat 'em, then make 'em an offer they can't refuse.
perkFx.raccoonMafia: Each enemy you beat joins the crew until the world ends (up to {recruitMax}), hitting for {recruitAtkPct}% of your ATK every {recruitEvery}s.
perkLine.energyDrink: The can was puffy. You drank it anyway.
perkLine.glassCannon: Hit like a garbage truck. Break like a bottle.
perkFx.playingPossum: Once per world, your first knockout leaves you standing at {secondWindPct}% HP.
perkLine.holdMySoda: The lower you sink, the harder you swing.
perkFx.holdMySoda: Below {rageBelowPct}% HP, your hits deal ×{rageMult} damage.
perkFx.yolo: Bosses take ×{bossDmgMult} damage, but regular enemies hit {regularAtkPct}% harder.
perkFx.greasedGears: The reels spin ×{spinSpeedMult} as fast, but bosses hit {bossAtkPct}% harder.
perkLine.fourLeafLitter: Found a whole bag of clovers. Lost the bag.
perkFx.fourLeafLitter: Luck tokens land ×{tokenChanceMult} as often, but your bag holds {bagCutPct}% less.
perkLine.pawnShopHustle: One raccoon's junk is another raccoon's rent.
perkLine.bootlegReel: Fell off a truck. Still spins. Mostly.
perkFx.bootlegReel: +{extraReels} reel on every spin, but every spin takes {spinTimePct}% longer.
perkLine.riggedJackpot: A little gum in the gears never hurt anybody.
perkFx.riggedJackpot: One spin in every {jackpotEvery} is rigged: every reel lands {rarity} or better.
perkLine.sourdoughStarter: A loaf that makes more loaves. Science!
perkFx.sourdoughStarter: Every {bonusLoafEvery} worlds you beat this run bake a bonus loaf.
perkLine.carbLoading: Why eat bread when you can hoard it?
perkFx.carbLoading: +{heldLoafLuckPct}% luck for every uneaten loaf in your pocket.
perkLine.breadBait: Bosses love bread. Bosses hate you.
perkFx.breadBait: Every world pays +{extraLoaves} loaf, but bosses have +{bossHpPct}% HP.
perkFx.holyCrust: +{eatenLoafPct}% ATK and max HP for every loaf you've eaten this run.
perkLine.glutenGolem: Knead it. Shape it. Unleash it.
perkFx.glutenGolem: Every {golemEvery}s a stale-bread golem slams the front enemy for {golemAtkPct}% of your ATK per loaf earned this run.
toast.breadOne: +{n} Half-Eaten Bread Loaf! Eat it in Upgrades > Perks.
toast.breadMany: +{n} Half-Eaten Bread Loaves! Eat them in Upgrades > Perks.
toast.rigged: RIGGED! Every reel lands {rarity} or better!

tierFlavor.devsOwn: The developer left this in the build. Please don't tell anyone.

tierFlavor.concept: Not a hat. The idea of every hat. You wear it with your mind.

dump.toughHint.swarm: Too tough! Swarms fall to Thundering and Explosive gear.

dump.toughHint.armored: Too tough! Armor: only crits get through. Roll for crit.
dump.toughHint.spiky: Too tough! Spikes hurt. Vampiric gear heals it back.
dump.toughHint.slippery: Too tough! They dodge. Echoing and Swift gear swing more.
dump.toughHint.giants: Too tough! Giants take Boss Damage. Upgrade it.
dump.toughHint.none: Too tough! Keep rolling. Grit builds the longer you stay.

stench.rottenLuck: Rotten Luck: gate bosses get one more move
stench.ratsInTheWalls: Rats in the Walls: enemies attack 30% faster
stench.raccoonFlu: Raccoon Flu: you have 25% less HP
stench.theSmell: The Smell: enemies +100% HP and ATK
